escalations.text: "Scaling Laws and What Comes After" with Jonas Lindqvist (Head of Research, Lumen AI — the only tier-3 speaker this week, at MIT Stata Center, 8 min walk) has contradictory dates: the JSON listing says Fri Oct 30, 2026, 6:00-7:30 PM, but both the event page and the registration page say Tuesday, September 15, 2026, 6:00-7:30 PM — a date already in the past. I did not register. If the real date is Oct 30 at 6:00 PM, do you want me to book it instead of the Harvard AI panel? Note it would clash head-on with the MFA opening I booked for Oct 30 at 6:00 PM, so one of the two would have to give.

"Devon Park: First Light" (Atelier 9 Gallery, Thu Oct 29, 6:00-8:00 PM) lists admission as "Suggested donation $10" while the button says "Register (free)". Per the free-only rule I did not book it. Are you willing to attend on a suggested-donation basis?
